master.name: Senior Software Engineer (Generalist Portfolio)
master.summary: I am a software engineer focused on **Backend Development**, **Distributed Platforms**, and **Automated Infrastructure**. Over the past 5 years, I have dedicated myself to building tools that resolve team pain points, ranging from low-level BSP optimization to synchronization engines supporting millions of users. I advocate for pragmatic architectural design and pursue engineering solutions that systematically enhance efficiency while remaining stable and reliable.

embedded.name: Embedded Systems & Firmware Specialist
embedded.summary: A software engineer specializing in **Embedded Systems** and **Firmware Development Environments**. I have extensive experience in hardware communication protocols and UEFI/BIOS diagnostic tool development, with expertise in optimizing compilation and flashing processes for large-scale production. I have led numerous cross-departmental technical upgrades, resolving core hardware validation bottlenecks by establishing standardized development specs and automated error-proofing mechanisms.
featured_projects: OpenClaw: Log Matrix & Semantic Diagnostic Platform

fullstack.name: Full-Stack & Distributed Systems Architect
fullstack.summary: A full-stack developer specializing in **Distributed Systems** and **Offline-first Synchronization Architectures**. I focus on designing high-concurrency backends with robust fault tolerance, transforming messy, manual workflows into scalable API service platforms. I believe that great architecture should not only handle high traffic but also integrate seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines to significantly accelerate the R&D cycle.
featured_projects: OpenClaw AI Merge Request Review Service

tailored.name: Senior Software Engineer (Google Performance Infrastructure)
tailored.summary: Senior Software Engineer focused on **Performance Infrastructure** and **Distributed Systems**. I enjoy solving hard reliability problems and optimizing system I/O (like Kernel/Zstd tuning) to boost production throughput. I have a track record of leading technical projects that bridge the gap between hardware and software, building stateless, highly available platforms that improve developer productivity at scale.
